nm2_3_explanatory_variables.detail: Quantile polynomial regression modeled dynamic characteristics as a function of age (including quadratic term) and sex.
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.supporting_text:
A quantile polynomial regression model was used to determine percentile curves based on the second-order polynomial regression.
For the healthy-base participant with index i, sexi encodes the participant's sex (male: 0, female: 1), agei is the modified age of the participant (physical age minus the average age of the healthy-base group).
